record.question: The main advantage of implementing a pharmacy operation software in day-to-day functioning of a community pharmacy is:
options: It provides real time inventory control and expiry management
It allows direct online ordering from the drug inspector portal
It can generate automatic prescriptions for audit purpose
It allows for tax exemption in billing
record.explanation: Answer A: It provides real time inventory control and expiry management. Pharmacy operations software can provide real-time stock and expiry tracking, helping reduce stockouts and expired inventory. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240015731. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
